Title: The Classic VMs retirement deadline is now September 6, 2023

Body.Content:
The deadline to migrate your Iaas VMs from Azure Service Manager to Azure Resource Manager is now September 6*, 2023. To avoid service disruption, we recommend that you complete your migration as soon as possible. We will not provide any additional extenstions after September 6, 2023. 

Additional resources: 

Learn more about Classic VMs retirement and common errors

Microsoft Q&A: Microsoft and community support

Contact our dedicated Azure migration support team for technical assistance. Customers without technical support can use the free support capability provided specifically for this migration. 

 

*The Classic VMs retirement deadline was previously September 1, 2023.
